title: Awaze Chicken Thigh Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 80ml of tej, (Ethiopian honey wine) or a dry sherry
ldInstructionsRaw: Begin by making the awaze paste. Mix together all the ingredients in a bowl, taste, and adjust seasoning with salt and lime juice
Pour the awaze paste over the chicken thighs and leave to marinate for at least 1 hour
Cook in the oven for 20 minutes, or until the juices run clear
Serve with the roasting juices drizzled over the top and lime wedges on the side
